remarks: Charming 1BR/1BA apartment with a private entrance. This unit will be freshly painted, professionally cleaned & delivered with new bedroom carpeting & new bathroom shower with flooring! New blinds being installed as well. Features include recessed lighting and an open floor plan, creating a bright and inviting living space. The kitchen offers ample cabinet storage and is equipped with a refrigerator, oven, and dishwasher. Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit full size washer and dryer, and a full bath with shower/tub combination. Landlord covers water, sewer, trash, lawn care, and snow removal. Sorry, no pets. Ideally located on a quiet, sidewalk-lined street, just a short walk to restaurants, shopping, and more. Excellent commuter location with easy access to Route 7, I-95, and the Merritt Parkway. Off-street parking included. One-year lease. First month's rent and two months' security deposit due at lease signing. Schedule your private showing today!
